reason: Melting the banded sample is the only offered action and should begin separating its grains.
expectation: I expect a small portion to thaw and leave solid material for examination, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: The melted portion can reveal the grains, but their original positions are lost; the rest remains cold.
reaction: That loss of spatial information is a useful reminder of what the test cannot show.
reason: Filtering the suspension is the only offered combination and should separate the solid grains.
expectation: I expect the cloth to retain the brown particles while the meltwater passes through, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: The filter retained the solids, and the next goal is to inspect them; their crowded arrangement may limit what I can see.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the grains separated from the water, though they are crowded together.
reason: The hand lens is the only offered combination and should let me examine the trapped particles.
expectation: I expect to see more detail in the grains, though I don't know what they will reveal.

effect: The filter revealed a ridged fragment, but its broken edge and the lost grain positions limit what can be inferred. An intact piece might remain in the frozen band.
reaction: The fragment is intriguing, and its crumbled edge makes the need to preserve the ice feel concrete.

mostWorthwhile.text: Finding the ridged fragment was the most worthwhile moment: it raised a new question while showing why an intact, frozen sample matters.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filtering was straightforward and offered little decision-making on its own, though it was necessary to inspect the grains.

surprise.text: I was surprised that melting the sample destroyed information about where the particles originally lay.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although each step had only one offered combination.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to learn whether an intact fragment can be recovered and what further examination might reveal.
